rules.text: Every Kamael AoE has affectLimit 5-12: it hits at most about 5 to 12 targets. "Mobs" in the rows means the minimum cluster size that makes the AoE worth more than single-target.
Board buffs are assumed (Might, Haste, Empower, Shield, Focus, Death Whisper, Wind Walk ...). Several Kamael self-buffs share an abnormal slot with board buffs and must not be auto-cast.

Souls: Soul Mastery is a passive that gains souls automatically from EXP and on crits. The soul cap grows with level: 5 at 5, 10 at 15, 20 at 36, 24 at 49, 30 at 62, 40 at 74. Souls expire 10 min after the last one is absorbed.
Almost every Kamael attack has soulMaxConsumeCount 5: it uses up to 5 souls per cast for bonus power and still works with 0 souls, just weaker. Never block an attack because souls are low.
Life to Soul 502 (40+): costs 193 to 328 HP and gives 1 to 5 souls, 11 s reuse, cannot be cast at 40 souls. Auto-use when souls < 5 && HP > 70% && (not in combat || target HP high).
Soul Gathering 625 (46+): gives +50 souls (capped), costs 10 Spirit Ore (3031) and 200 HP, 30 min reuse. Auto-use before a pull or a raid when souls < 10 and Spirit Ore >= 10.
Soul Rage 939 (78+): +1 soul per cast and a 0-power hit for 25 HP and 5 MP. Only a filler while the main skills are on cooldown and souls < 5. Never spam it at 40 souls.

Final Form 538 (79+): needs and uses 20 souls plus 200 HP; a 5 min transform that doubles P.Atk, P.Def, M.Atk and M.Def, 1 hour reuse. The normal skill bar is replaced by transform skills. Never auto-use it unless the bot has a transform skill set; manual for raids and PvP (unc: which normal skills stay usable while transformed).
Increase Power 1432 (PA_UP) shares a slot with Might and Chant of Battle: never cast it while board Might is up (it is weaker, +8/12% vs +15%).
Rapid Attack 469 (ATTACK_TIME_DOWN) shares a slot with Haste and Chant of Fury: never cast it while Haste is up.
Soul to Empower 1441 (MA_UP) shares a slot with Empower: never cast it while Empower is up.
Furious Soul 482 (PA_UP_SPECIAL) shares a slot with Rage: fine unless a Rage buff is present.
Sword Shield 483 and Prahnah 1470 (PD_UP_SPECIAL) share a slot with Ultimate Defense, Vengeance, Harmony/Symphony of Noblesse and each other: emergency only; do not overwrite each other.
Dark Weapon 1443 (HOLY_ATTACK) shares a slot with Holy Weapon and Fire/Ice/Wind/Earth Weapon: only cast it if no other weapon-element buff is on the target.
Courage 499 (RESIST_SPIRITLESS) shares a slot with Lionheart: situational.
Soul Barrier 1514 (PD_UP_BOW) shares a slot with Deflect Arrow: emergency.
Appetite for Destruction 1476, Protection Instinct 1478, Vampiric Impulse 1477, Magic Impulse 1479 and Soul Harmony 1480 share the INSTINCT slot: only one Inspector "instinct" is active at a time.

Weapons: Ancient Sword (2H) for Trooper/Berserker/Doombringer; Rapier (1H) for Soul Breaker/Soul Hound/Inspector/Judicator melee; Crossbow for Warder/Arbalester/Trickster. The Soul Breaker/Soul Hound magic skills (Abyssal Blaze 1433, Soul of Pain 1436, Dark Flame 1437, Annihilation Circle 1438, Soul Strike 1516, Soul Vortex 1512, Leopold 1469) have no weapon requirement.

Change Weapon 1473 converts the equipped D-grade or higher weapon (2H sword <-> Ancient Sword, 1H sword <-> Rapier, Bow <-> Crossbow; enchant, SA and attribute carry over; augmented weapons cannot be converted; 15 s reuse). It is a one-time setup action, never a combat skill: never auto-use it.

Charge skills cannot be used in melee: Shoulder Charge 494, Blade Rush 495, Storm Assault 493 and Rush Impact 793 have target mindistance 200. Only cast them when the target is >= 200 units away (gap-closers / openers).
Checkmate 506 needs a rapier and Death Mark 1435 on the target.
Contagion 498 needs an ancient sword and a bleed on the target (from Blade Rush 495).
Soul Vortex Extinction 1513 needs Soul Vortex 1512 on the target and removes it.
Restoration Impact 1488 needs Restoration 1487 on the target.
Deadly Roulette 510 needs your own HP <= 10%.
Owner rule (2026-10-10): all toggles run ONLY in fights. "Always on" in the tables means "on whenever fighting", including Dark Armor 481 and Dark Blade 480 (no MP drain).

Owner rule (2026-10-02 a): no self-buffs while board buffs are on. Exceptions the board does not give: Dark Weapon 1443 and Pride of Kamael 1444 (swarm.js partyBuffs.inspector keeps these up), Furious Soul 482, Blood Pact 834, Fast Shot 490 and Lightning Barrier 1515 share no slot with board buffs; whether those exceptions are allowed is the owner's call (unc).
Always-never: Detect Trap 470 and Defuse Trap 471 are only for player traps or chests.
Always-never: Erase Mark 1475 removes Death Mark from a target; its only use is cleansing an ally hit by an enemy Kamael. Never auto-cast it on a mob (it would remove your own Death Mark).
Always-never: Change Weapon 1473 (see the weapon rule).
Always-never: Hard March 479 (+20 run speed, MP drain) is a travel toggle only: on when moving with no target, off in combat (or ignore it if Wind Walk is up).
Always-never: Soul Harmony 1480 is a party-wide Stun + P.Def x0.1 + 200 MP restore. NEVER auto-use it: it stuns and strips your own party.
Filter by the equipped weapon: Fallen Attack 468 fails with an ancient sword, rapier skills fail on a Doombringer, crossbow skills fail on a rapier user.
Sharpshooting 521 roots you: never use it while kiting. Temptation 511 and Scorn 503 pull aggro.
